clauses.clause: Scorching Dragonfire deals 3 damage to target creature
clauses.evidence: target slot (cast): 1..1 of the six creatures; [cast targets=['you_giant']] you_giant is dealt 3 damage (damage 0 -> 3), same for opp_giant; mana R-1 W-1.
No planeswalker on the probe board. Pack scorching_dragonfire_4: the opponent's Vivien Reid (loyalty 3) is a legal target, loses 3 loyalty.

clauses.clause: If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead (dying from this spell's damage).
clauses.evidence: [cast targets=['you_bear']]: you_bear is dealt 3, card moves stack -> graveyard, you_bear moves battlefield -> exile (by card/MOVE_ZONE); likewise opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear; the 4/4s survive with 3 damage.

clauses.clause: (... would die THIS TURN from any source; only THAT creature or planeswalker)
clauses.evidence: Packs: scorching_dragonfire_1 (the surviving 4/4 dealt 1 more by another source the same turn: exiled, not in the graveyard), scorching_dragonfire_2 (next turn the 4/4 dies: graveyard), scorching_dragonfire_3 (an untargeted creature dying the same turn: graveyard), scorching_dragonfire_4 (planeswalker at 0 loyalty: exiled).
